listing.name: Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium Portraits Pack
listing.summary: Adds 350+ portraits from Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium characters to player and vanilla factions, along with 7 faction flags.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 350+ portraits from Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium characters to player and vanilla factions, along with 7 faction flags.

description:
Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium Portraits Pack

DOWNLOAD LINK [v1.3.0]

Contains 350+ portraits from characters of Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium sequel, added to your player faction and other vanilla factions.

Also includes 7 flags from factions you encounter throughout the story.

Should be safe to download and drop right into your modpack.

Shouldn't lag your device unless you install the other portrait packs...

Portraits Preview

"It's been 10 years, Commander. Feeling old yet?"

[close]

Flags Preview

Please use the

Girls' Frontline 1

Base Pack instead if you would like to use flags related to major Girls' Frontline factions.

This pack attempts to avoid overlapping its content with that from other packs from the same franchise.

[close]

Included Contents

Base Pack & FlagsOutfit Boutique - Skins PackWhite Zone Pack - Notable Characters PackBounty Hunted Pack -  Mob Enemies Pack

Certain overlapping content from previous Girls' Frontline franchise titles were exempt from this modpack.

[close]

Changelogs(MM/DD/YY Format)

1.3.0 - 05/23/26

Welrod Patch Update - I've seen the "Truth"
    
    Added 4 portraits to the Base pack. (1 moved from NPC pack)
    Added 2 flags to the Base pack + fixed 1 flag that was broken.
    Added 4 portraits to the Outfit Boutique pack.
    Added 7 portraits to the White Zone Pack.

    No really, I can't wait until I can (legally) update the portraits pack. I saw some cool lore stuff.

1.2.0 - 04/14/26

Chiral Redundancy - Part 2 update.
    
Added 10 portraits to the Base pack.
Added 2 flags for Mokosh and the Brokers to the Base pack.
Added 13 portrait to the Outfit Boutique pack.
Moved 2 portraits from the White Zone Pack to the Outfit Boutique Pack. 
Added 24 portraits to the White Zone Pack.
Added 5 portraits to the Bounty Hunted pack.

1.1.0 - 03/10/26

First of the 1.X.0 updates, likely not save compatible. 

Added version checking support.
Added 1 portrait to the Base Pack.
Added 1 portrait to the Outfit Boutique Pack.
Moved 2 portraits from the White Zone Pack to the Outfit Boutique Pack.
Added 5 portraits to the White Zone Pack.

1.0.0 - 02/21/26 - Initial Forums Release

[close]

AcknowledgementsBase portraits were sourced from Girls' Frontline official artworks, and belongs to Sunborn / MICA Team.

Special thanks to "A Network Security Assistant" and the GFL2 CN community for helping me with the creation of this portraits pack.

[close]

Back to the saddle, commanders. Love and hope has never been out of the menu.

NOTICE:

This pack will be actively updated, please pay attention to the mod's version and avoid updating this portrait pack halfway through your campaign, as updates may change the location of certain portraits due to story developments.
